## Wyrmling Green Dragon (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
 LE Small dragon (air)  
 **Init** +2; **Senses** dragon senses; Perception +10  

**Defense**

 **AC** 17, touch 13, flat-footed 15 (+2 Dex, +4 natural, +1 size)  
 **hp** 65 (5d12+5)  
 **Fort** +5, **Ref** +6, **Will** +6  
 **Immune** acid, paralysis, sleep  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 150 ft. (average), swim 40 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +8 (1d6+1), 2 claws +7 (1d4+1)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (20-ft. cone, DC 13, 2d6 acid)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 13, **Dex** 14, **Con** 13, **Int** 10, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 10  
 **Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +5; **CMD** 17 (21 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** Alertness, Iron Will, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
 **Skills** Fly +12, Knowledge (nature) +8, Perception +10, Stealth +14, Survival +8, Swim +17; **Racial Modifiers** +8 Swim  
 **Languages** Draconic  
 **SQ** water breathing  

**Special Abilities**

 **Water Breathing (Ex)**  A green dragon can breathe underwater indefinitely and can freely use its breath weapon, spells, and other abilities while submerged.

**Ecology**

 **Environment** temperate forests  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** triple
